finish watching a movie or episode
send a family video to relatives

reasoning: A framed play button is the universal symbol for online video, tutorials, screencasts, and YouTube. It fits a very common family of everyday tasks around watching, editing, recording, or uploading videos, though it sits close to film-strip/clapperboard icons for movies and camera icons for video calls.
